text_block_list.text:
On the way back from buying
new horseshoes with Oguri Cap—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That shop is...
choice_data_list: That's the regional specialty shop Oguri helped out at.
That's the regional specialty shop Oguri helped out at, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Takes me back.
Working as a shop clerk was actually pretty fun."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me, could you be—
Oguri Cap-san...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ah, yes, but...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
We're huge fans of yours, Oguri-san!
We're always cheering you on!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, um...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I'm very glad.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I draw strength from the cheering as well.
So, um... thank you, as always.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all! It's me who
draws courage from watching you run, Oguri-san!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Yes! Best of luck in your future races!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Please continue to cheer me on.

"Although still a bit awkward,
Oguri Cap seemed to have learned to handle things calmly."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Trainer, sorry to keep you waiting.
choice_data_list: All that practice paid off.
All that practice paid off.
You've grown once again.
You've grown a little more, haven't you?
Getting used to being surrounded by people your own age?
Getting used to being surrounded by people your own age?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Trainer, sorry to keep you waiting.
choice_data_list: All that practice paid off.
All that practice paid off.
You've grown once again.
You've grown a little more, haven't you?
Getting used to being surrounded by people your own age?
Getting used to being surrounded by people your own age?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...It's all thanks to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I think I was able to serve the customers properly thanks to your advice.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"It was reassuring having you watching over me by my side.
...I am grateful."
choice_data_list: You're welcome.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it, I told Tama about the time I helped out at the shop.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Then, she said,
"My Trainer is like my dad."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Then, she said,
"My Trainer is like my mom."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Should I start calling you "Dad" from now on?
choice_data_list: J-just stay as my Trainer, okay!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Should I start calling you "Mom" from now on?
choice_data_list: J-just stay as my Trainer, okay!

text_block_list.text:
Feeling joyful at the trust Oguri Cap placed in me,
the two of us headed home.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I suppose so... Heh.
choice_data_list: Something wrong?
Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The way you said that just now sounded just like Shige-san.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The way you said that just now sounded just like Tome-san.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Talking to you always puts me at ease, Trainer.
I've always found it rather curious, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you remind me of home.
Like Shige-san... or rather, like my hometown itself.
choice_data_list: Similar, as in their vibe?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you remind me of home.
Like Tome-san... or rather, like my hometown itself.
choice_data_list: Similar, as in their vibe?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... Someday, I want you to visit my hometown too,
Trainer. I'm sure you'll love it.
When that time comes, just like today, I wanted everyone to see how Oguri Cap had grown—not just as a racer, but as a young girl too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're right, even if it's little by little.
...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Can I keep relying on you... whenever I need someone to talk to...?
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks. It's really nice having your help
with things outside of racing, too."

Feeling the firm bond established between myself
and Oguri Cap, the two of us headed home.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks. Things are so different from back home
that I've been feeling pretty lost."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Even just taking the train, the stations are so huge I get lost, or I can't seem to scan my card properly...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Just the thought of transferring trains makes my head spin.
choice_data_list: Shall we practice getting used to trains next time?
Do you want to practice getting used to trains next time?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... That sounds great.
If it's with you, Trainer, it'll definitely be fun.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Once I get used to it, I want to take the train to all sorts of places.
And when I arrive, eat lots of delicious food—
(Grrrr~)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Just imagining it is making me hungry.
Trainer, want to grab a bite before heading back?

On the way to the family restaurant,
I let my thoughts drift to the train trip
I would take with Oguri Cap someday.
